title: Primus Monthly Engineering Report — 2026-08
key_findings: SANITY FLAG: the window spans ~62 days, beyond the 45-day monthly threshold. This is expected for a backfill and was not truncated; flagged for human sanity-check.

123 PRs merged to main in the window. Largest categories: Other 53 (mostly feature work, incl. a large Flux/diffusion backend series and DeepSeek-V4 support), Bug Fix 25, CI/Infra 18, Turbo/Dependency Version Update 11, Docs 9, Performance Optimization 5, Refactor 2.

BACKEND PIN CHANGE IN WINDOW: third_party/torchtitan was bumped from 5fb7cc2e (v0.1.0) to 73a0e697 (v0.2.2 tag) in PR #871 (merged 2026-07-17). Because this submodule SHA change is inside the window, the torchtitan/upstream-main backend-gap report set was regenerated this run.

torchtitan upstream drift: pin 73a0e697 (v0.2.2, 2026-02-20) is 741 commits behind upstream HEAD 681fd4b5 (2026-08-01); diff 698 files, +123580/-35965. Notable upstream since pin: Kimi K2 (#3532), Qwen 3.5, GPT-OSS enablement, graph_trainer/rl/torchft experiments, DeepEP v2 cudagraphable APIs (#3808), remote fsspec checkpoints (#3887). Recommendation: plan sync.

Megatron-LM upstream drift: pin d3528a21 (2026-03-06) is UNCHANGED in the window and is now 1050 commits behind upstream HEAD df2da78b (2026-08-03). No Megatron backend-gap regeneration this run. Notable upstream: Megatron-FSDP A2A/HybridEP overlap, CUDA-graph ADAM optimizer, DCP/FSDP async save, MoE routing metrics, MXFP8 improvements. Recommendation: plan sync.

Primus-Turbo Q3 quarterly drift (anchor 2026-07-01 00:00 GMT+8): CI pin advanced +67 (3c39ef25 #355 -> 9b5d3092 #429); benchmark pin advanced +35 (3c39ef25 #355 -> a04a233c #386); CI is +32 ahead of benchmark. AITER moved b5e03ed1 -> 0f3c58e6 (v0.1.14.post1); TRITON 88b227e2 -> 09500db9; UCCL 5afb4117 unchanged. All pin movement landed in-window (PRs #830, #806). Primus-Turbo has no standalone backend-gap report; tracked in the quarterly drift section. Recommendation: monitor.

Backend-gap regenerated this run: torchtitan/upstream-main only (submodule SHA changed in-window). Megatron-LM, Megatron-Bridge, Emerging-Optimizers, HummingbirdXT, maxtext, and mamba submodules were unchanged in the window.
